import asyncio

from ldf.attributes.controls import LawoHomeNativeControl
from ldf.models.base import LawoHomeNativeDevice
from ldf.production import create_home_native




[docs]
def ctls_frame_sync(device_object: LawoHomeNativeDevice, config: dict[str, bool]):
    """Generate modified fs enable ctls for all defined sdi inputs"""

    for sdi_in, status in config.items():
        page = device_object.controls.advanced['SdiInput'][sdi_in]['SyncHV']
        ctl = page.controls['Enable']
        ctl.value.value = status
        yield ctl






[docs]
def ctls_tone_generator(device_object: LawoHomeNativeDevice, config: dict[str, bool]):
    """Generate modified tone generator enable ctls for all defined sdi inputs"""

    for sdi_in, status in config.items():
        page = device_object.controls.advanced['SdiInput'][sdi_in]['Tones']
        ctl = page.controls['Enable']
        ctl.value.value = status
        yield ctl






[docs]
async def main():

    dev_cfg = {
        "frame_sync": {
            "sdiIn1": True,
        },
        "tone_gen": {
            "sdiIn1": True,
        }
    }

    device_object = await create_home_native(
        lawo_type=".edge",
        guid="a8eb8602-5a30-3762-bc50-a054f46fdc73",
        client_addrs=["home1-1.ralab.lawo.de"]
    )

    all_fs_ctls = [x for x in ctls_frame_sync(device_object, dev_cfg['frame_sync'])]
    all_tone_ctls = [x for x in ctls_tone_generator(device_object, dev_cfg['tone_gen'])]

    async with device_object:
        await device_object.controls.set(
            all_fs_ctls + all_tone_ctls
        )



if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
